actual_exposure.limits: This assesses the stated design only. It does not establish implementation correctness, blind-label independence, reviewer coverage, or human effectiveness.

answers.required_evidence_accessible: Yes, as specified: complete static Python headers and owners, explicit module scope, complete Markdown source and target companions, derived inventories, and revision-bound missing-target evidence supply the relevant context without executing source or resolving new references. This conclusion depends on pagination remaining complete and losslessly mapped.
answers.full_context_avoids_anchor_position_gues: Yes. Original Markdown makes explicit anchors and examples inspectable, while derived heading rows and the supported anchor-ID set describe parser output. Keep the set labeled as membership; it cannot establish the occurrence count or source position of an anchor.
answers.missing_provenance: Clarify how chunks of a source line wider than the page are mapped: retain the original line and start/end Unicode-column spans, or an equivalent exact reversible mapping. A source row alone is insufficient to pinpoint a wrapped substring. Bind the mapping with the page/index hashes already proposed.
answers.unsafe_scope_expansion: None apparent. The explicit offline VerifiedReferenceContext precondition and source/renderer/reference matching keep reference context bounded. Do not expand this task into verification of arbitrary caller-forged proof objects or new filesystem/network resolution.
answers.needless_machinery: None required beyond the proposed benchmark builder, finite linked pages, mappings, and digest bindings. Full-source companions avoid a production parser API expansion. Preserve the existing builder and frozen packets.

smallest_correction: Specify reversible source-column mapping for wrapped long lines, including the column unit and preservation of original LF/CRLF bytes.

Reject an impossible page envelope explicitly before returning a bundle when repeated instructions, questions, absolute links, or other mandatory metadata cannot fit 80 lines by 80 code points. Do not truncate, omit mandatory context, return a partial bundle, or paginate without making progress.
essential_failing_tests_before_coding: A focus in a nested Python owner receives enclosing class/function headers, decorators, async syntax and complete multiline signatures; colon-bearing defaults or annotations do not end the header early. Module scope is explicit and malformed/unsupported input fails.

Long raw lines with non-ASCII characters, repeated substrings and CRLF round-trip exactly through chunk maps while every complete page satisfies both bounds; wrapped positions identify the original substring unambiguously.
Oversized caller instructions/questions or absolute output links cause a clear finite failure rather than truncation, partial output or no-progress pagination.

Markdown with duplicate headings, explicit HTML anchors and relevant examples retains full source companions, ordered duplicate heading rows and membership-only anchor IDs; generated/unsupported input fails rather than yielding a misleading empty inventory.

M012 rejects mismatched source bytes/ID, renderer, incomplete reference declarations, unknown/unbound targets and unsupported target content; valid targets expose complete bytes/hash/inventory and pinned absence retains its native provenance bindings without new resolution.

Multiple pages have complete index coverage, correct roles/order/previous-next links and bound source maps; a changed page/context/index value changes its appropriate hash/digest, with existing build_reading behavior and frozen packets unchanged.
